reason: Stack exhaustion when braces expands deeply nested patterns. No patched braces release exists (3.0.3 is the latest and the advisory covers <=3.0.3). It is reached only through Tailwind CSS 3 (chokidar, fast-glob, micromatch), which runs at build time on this repository's own glob patterns; no user input reaches it and none of it is in the shipped bundle. Remove this exception by upgrading to Tailwind CSS 4, which drops these dependencies.
